capture_basis: active managed permission profile and exposed root tool surface supplied to the controller before Run 0b starts; persisted while the eight-start collection was in progress
controller_observable_credential_environ: not exposed without inspecting process environment; not inspected
network_profile: root tool surface includes web retrieval and the environment reports network enabled; subjects were instructed not to use either

observability.service_auth_or_launch_tokens: unavailable without credential inspection; not inspected

subject_tool_surface: not independently observable; collaboration workers may inherit exposed tools
tool_policy: prompts prohibit tools, web, delegation, repository inspection, messaging, code execution, shell commands, and external files
